title: Event triggering - documentWrite
description: A DOM event listener reads data from an event or input and writes it directly to the document using document.write().
objectives: Trace how the input value is written to the document via document.write().
hints: Input an HTML payload like and click Render Content.
body:
Event Listener (document.write sink)

Clicking the button writes the input content directly to the document using document.write().
